mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, retention_days AS retentionDays, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tenant_telemetry_retention WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_telemetry_retention ( tenant_id, retention_days, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{retentionDays}, #{updatedBy}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET retention_days = EXCLUDED.retention_days, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM device_telemetry dt USING tenant_telemetry_retention r WHERE dt.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND dt.ts < now() - make_interval(days => r.retention_days)
DELETE FROM device_telemetry dt WHERE dt.ts < now() - make_interval(days => #{defaultDays}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tenant_telemetry_retention r WHERE r.tenant_id = dt.tenant_id )
mapper.select:
SELECT bucket, avg_value AS avgValue, max_value AS maxValue, min_value AS minValue, sum_value AS sumValue, sample_count AS sampleCount, last_value AS lastValue FROM device_telemetry_hourly WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND device_id = #{deviceId} AND property = #{property}
AND bucket >= CAST(#{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
AND bucket <= CAST(#{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
ORDER BY bucket DESC

SELECT bucket, avg_value AS avgValue, max_value AS maxValue, min_value AS minValue, sum_value AS sumValue, sample_count AS sampleCount, last_value AS lastValue FROM device_telemetry_daily WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND device_id = #{deviceId} AND property = #{property}
AND bucket >= CAST(#{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
AND bucket <= CAST(#{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
ORDER BY bucket DESC
